name: modal.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  modal.scss — MANIFEST for the expand modal (dialog.modal-above) + below
//  content lock. Split by surface into modal/ partials (imported below):
//    _scroll-lock    html.modal-open locks + the fullscreen dialog layer
//    _expand-modal   expand-modal layout + genie zoom keyframes
//    _pref-close     circular WebGL close button (+ canvas fallback)
//  Fullscreen dialog over the page with the media figure expanded inside;
//  scroll-lock on html/body mirrors the JS scroll-lock in App.js.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';

$_B_EXPAND: 'expand-modal';
$_B_PREF_CLOSE: 'pref-close';

@import 'modal/scroll-lock';
@import 'modal/expand-modal';
@import 'modal/pref-close';

// Keyboard focus ring on this shadow root's tabbable elements — the file
// doesn't import _structure (which emits it globally), so include the
// shared scope explicitly.
@include focus-ring-scope;
